what_happened: The job to split status rendering out of display.rs into a submodule was rejected at the final verdict. One check failed: the test check (shard 1 of 6, athena-core --lib, 1 of 11 units). There were two findings. The blocker: the move broke an existing test, mistake_tests::every_measure_label_names_a_status_view_field_and_a_printed_line, which reads display.rs's source text, so the full suite failed. The major finding: the accepted reading did not match the request, so passing criteria did not show the request was met. No acceptance criteria are listed as unmet. The failed check and the findings are separate things.
cause: Existing tests can read source files as text. Moving code between files therefore breaks them even when behavior is unchanged. Nothing in the reading or the producer's flow finds the tests that read the moved file's text before the move, or requires the full test suite to be run and fixed on the producer's side. The reading also fit the named function rather than the request's outcome, so nothing prompted a search for dependents. The class is a loose fit: 20261025-070501-16qb is about a plan leaving test impact open and failing in planning, whereas here it was found only at the final verdict.
prevention: Before dispatching a move or split job, run a check that searches the test sources for reads of the file or symbols being moved (for example include_str! or fs reads of display.rs) and lists them in the reading as files the job must update. The producer must run the full athena-core --lib tests after the move and fix or repoint those tests in the same job, with the reading allowing those test edits. The gate counts show 0 disagreements for every gate, so no gate is relaxed or removed.
proposed_request: Split the status rendering code out of crates/athena-core/src/display.rs into a submodule, with no change in behavior. Before moving anything, find every test that reads display.rs's source text or depends on where the status rendering lives, including mistake_tests::every_measure_label_names_a_status_view_field_and_a_printed_line in status.rs. Update those tests to read the new location, and keep them checking what they checked before. Edits to those tests are within scope. Acceptance: display.rs holds no status rendering code and the new submodule holds it; the printed status output is unchanged, shown by running the status tests before and after; the existing source-reading tests still pass against the new location; and the full workspace cargo test, clippy and fmt are clean.
